_comment: Seed data for the calisthenics app. Mirrors the prototype's exercise library and predefined plans. Use to populate the local DB (SQLite/Preferences) on first launch. Equipment values: 'none' | 'pull-up bar' | 'dip station' | 'bench' | 'wall' | 'bar/table'. type: 'reps' | 'hold'. muscle groups: Chest, Back, Shoulders, Arms, Core, Legs, Full Body (primary is the filter group; secondary is free text).

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: The foundational horizontal press. Builds chest, shoulders and triceps with zero equipment.
cues: Hands just wider than shoulders, fingers spread.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes — body in one line.
Lower until your chest is a fist above the floor.
Drive up explosively, elbows tucked ~45°.
mistakes: Flaring elbows out to 90° — strains shoulders.
Sagging hips or piking up.

exercises.name: Incline Push-ups
exercises.description: Hands elevated reduces load — the perfect entry to pressing.
cues: Place hands on a stable raised surface.
Keep a straight line head to heels.
Lower chest to the edge with control.
mistakes: Surface too high removes the challenge.
Letting hips drop.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-ups
exercises.description: Hands together shifts the load onto the triceps for serious arm strength.
cues: Form a diamond with thumbs and index fingers.
Keep elbows tucked tight to your sides.
Lower until chest touches your hands.
mistakes: Elbows flaring outward.
Partial range of motion.

exercises.name: Pike Push-ups
exercises.description: A vertical press that builds toward the handstand push-up.
cues: Pike hips high, body in an inverted V.
Lower the crown of your head toward the floor.
Press back up through the shoulders.
mistakes: Hips too low (becomes a regular push-up).
Bending at the waist instead of pressing.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.description: A powerful vertical pushing movement for triceps and lower chest.
cues: Start at the top, arms locked.
Lower until shoulders dip just below elbows.
Lean slightly forward for more chest.
mistakes: Going too deep and stressing shoulders.
Shrugging the shoulders up.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.description: The king of pulling movements — builds a strong, wide back.
cues: Grip overhand, just wider than shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar, lead with elbows.
Control the descent to a full hang.
mistakes: Kipping / using momentum.
Not reaching full extension at the bottom.

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.description: Underhand grip emphasises the biceps while still hammering the back.
cues: Grip underhand, shoulder width.
Pull until chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Swinging the legs.
Half reps.

exercises.name: Inverted Rows
exercises.description: A horizontal pull — the best entry point to building pulling strength.
cues: Hang under a waist-high bar, body straight.
Pull chest to the bar, squeeze shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
mistakes: Letting hips sag.
Shrugging instead of retracting.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.description: The fundamental lower-body movement for quads and glutes.
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit hips back and down, chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
mistakes: Knees caving inward.
Heels lifting off the floor.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: A single-leg movement that builds balance and unilateral strength.
cues: Step forward, lower the back knee toward the floor.
Keep front shin vertical.
Push back to the start.
mistakes: Front knee travelling past the toes.
Leaning the torso forward.

exercises.name: Pistol Squats
exercises.description: A single-leg squat demanding strength, balance and mobility.
cues: Extend one leg forward, arms out for balance.
Descend slowly on the working leg.
Keep heel planted and chest up.
mistakes: Collapsing at the bottom.
Heel lifting.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: An isometric hold that builds deep core stability.
cues: Forearms under shoulders.
Body in one straight line, glutes squeezed.
Breathe steadily — do not let hips sag.
mistakes: Hips rising or dropping.
Holding the breath.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.description: A gymnastics staple that builds total anterior-core tension.
cues: Lie down, press lower back into the floor.
Lift shoulders and legs, arms overhead.
Maintain the dish shape.
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor.
Legs too high, reducing tension.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.description: Targets the lower abs through hip flexion.
cues: Lie flat, hands under your hips.
Raise straight legs to vertical.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
mistakes: Using momentum to swing.
Lower back lifting off the floor.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: A dynamic core and conditioning move.
cues: Start in a push-up position.
Drive knees toward your chest alternately.
Keep hips low and core tight.
mistakes: Bouncing the hips up.
Going too fast and losing form.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.description: A full-body conditioning movement that spikes the heart rate.
cues: Drop to a squat, kick feet back.
Do a push-up, hop feet in.
Jump up explosively.
mistakes: Sloppy push-up portion.
Landing with locked knees.

exercises.name: Handstand Hold
exercises.description: A signature skill building shoulder strength and balance.
cues: Kick up against a wall, hands shoulder-width.
Stack hips over shoulders over hands.
Push the floor away, squeeze everything.
mistakes: Over-arching the lower back (banana shape).
Not pushing tall through the shoulders.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Isolates and strengthens the glutes and posterior chain.
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Drive hips up, squeeze glutes at the top.
Lower with control.
mistakes: Over-extending the lower back.
Pushing through the toes.

exercises.name: Muscle-ups
exercises.description: The explosive transition from a pull-up into a dip above the bar — the gateway calisthenics skill.
cues: Start from a dead hang with a false grip.
Pull explosively, chest toward the bar.
Lean forward and roll your wrists over the bar.
Press out of the bottom of the dip to lock out.
mistakes: Chicken-winging one arm over first.
Relying on a big kip instead of strength.

exercises.name: Wide Push-ups
exercises.description: A wider hand stance hits the chest harder and eases the load on the triceps.
cues: Place hands wider than shoulder-width, fingers slightly turned out.
Lower with control until your chest nears the floor.
Drive back up while keeping your body in one straight line.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag.
Flaring the neck and shoulders up to the ears.

exercises.name: Knee Push-ups
exercises.description: The easiest way to build real pressing strength toward your first full push-up.
cues: Kneel and walk your hands out so the body is straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up without letting the hips drop or pike.
mistakes: Sticking the butt in the air.
Bending only at the hips instead of the elbows.

exercises.name: Wall Push-ups
exercises.description: The gentlest push-up entry point — perfect for absolute beginners or warm-ups.
cues: Stand arm's length from a wall, hands flat at shoulder height.
Bend the elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to a straight-arm start, keeping the body rigid.
mistakes: Standing too close, which removes the resistance.
Letting the lower back arch.

exercises.name: Decline Push-ups
exercises.description: Elevating the feet shifts the focus to the upper chest and shoulders.
cues: Place your feet on a bench with hands on the floor in push-up position.
Lower until your chest reaches floor level.
Press up while bracing your core to keep a straight line.
mistakes: Sagging hips under the steeper angle.
Flaring the elbows wide.

exercises.name: Archer Push-ups
exercises.description: Shift your weight onto one arm at a time — a powerful step toward the one-arm push-up.
cues: Set hands wide, one arm straight out to the side as a kickstand.
Bend the working arm and lower toward that hand.
Press back up, then alternate sides each rep.
mistakes: Bending the straight "support" arm to cheat.
Rotating the hips instead of staying square.

exercises.name: Clap Push-ups
exercises.description: Explosive push-ups that build power, speed, and serious upper-body force.
cues: Lower into a controlled push-up.
Drive up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Clap, then land softly with bent elbows to absorb the impact.
mistakes: Landing on locked, stiff arms.
Not generating enough push to fully leave the floor.

exercises.name: One-Arm Push-ups
exercises.description: The ultimate test of unilateral pressing strength and full-body tension.
cues: Set feet wide for balance and place one hand behind your back.
Lower under control while keeping the torso square to the floor.
Press back up without twisting toward the working arm.
mistakes: Twisting the body to recruit other muscles.
Using a stance too narrow to balance.

exercises.name: Spiderman Push-ups
exercises.description: A push-up that drives a knee to the elbow, blending chest strength with core control.
cues: Lower into a push-up while pulling one knee toward the same-side elbow.
Touch the bottom of the push-up, then return the leg.
Alternate sides on each repetition.
mistakes: Letting the hip rotate up.
Dropping the knee instead of driving it forward.

exercises.name: Hindu Push-ups
exercises.description: A flowing dive-bomb push-up that builds pressing strength alongside shoulder mobility.
cues: Start in a downward-dog pike with hips high.
Swoop your chest down and forward, skimming close to the floor.
Press up and back to the start, leading with the hips.
mistakes: Rushing the swoop and losing control.
Barely bending the elbows on the way through.

exercises.name: Staggered Push-ups
exercises.description: Offset hands load each side unevenly to prep for single-arm strength.
cues: Place one hand forward and the other slightly back.
Lower with control, keeping the body straight.
Press up, then swap hand positions each set.
mistakes: Letting the torso twist toward the forward hand.
Uneven set counts between sides.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-ups
exercises.description: Press your full bodyweight overhead for elite vertical pushing strength.
cues: Kick up to a handstand against a wall with hands shoulder-width.
Lower under control until the top of your head nears the floor.
Press back up to a full lockout without arching the back.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back into the wall.
Flaring the elbows out wide.

exercises.name: Elevated Pike Push-ups
exercises.description: Feet raised on a bench steepens the angle to bridge toward handstand push-ups.
cues: Place feet on a bench and hips high in an inverted-V pike.
Lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press straight back up, keeping the hips stacked over the shoulders.
mistakes: Letting the hips drift back into a push-up.
Collapsing the head forward instead of down.

exercises.name: Wall Walks
exercises.description: Walk your feet up a wall to build handstand confidence and shoulder endurance.
cues: Start in a push-up with feet at the base of a wall.
Walk your feet up while stepping your hands closer to the wall.
Reverse the movement slowly back to the floor.
mistakes: Rushing and losing control on the way down.
Letting the lower back sag.

exercises.name: Crow Pose
exercises.description: A balance hold that builds wrist, shoulder, and core strength for advanced skills.
cues: Squat with hands planted shoulder-width on the floor.
Rest your knees against the backs of your upper arms.
Lean forward and lift your feet, balancing on your hands.
mistakes: Looking down instead of slightly forward.
Placing the knees too low on the arms.

exercises.name: Pseudo Planche Lean
exercises.description: Lean your weight forward over your hands to build the foundation for the planche.
cues: Start in a push-up position with hands by your hips, fingers turned out.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands.
Hold the lean with a tight core and protracted shoulders.
mistakes: Letting the hips pike up.
Leaning from the hips rather than the shoulders.

exercises.name: Bench Dips
exercises.description: A scalable triceps builder using a bench or chair — no dip station needed.
cues: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands gripping beside your hips.
Slide your hips off and lower by bending the elbows straight back.
Press up until the arms are nearly locked.
mistakes: Flaring elbows out to the sides.
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.

exercises.name: Korean Dips
exercises.description: Dips behind a straight bar that hammer the triceps through a brutal range.
cues: Support yourself above a bar with it behind your back.
Lower under control, keeping the bar close to your body.
Press back up to a full lockout.
mistakes: Letting the bar drift away from the body.
Rushing past a controlled bottom position.

exercises.name: Sphinx Push-ups
exercises.description: A forearm-to-hand push-up that isolates the triceps like nothing else bodyweight.
cues: Start in a forearm plank.
Press up onto your hands by extending only at the elbows.
Lower slowly back to the forearms, keeping the body rigid.
mistakes: Pushing from the hips instead of the elbows.
Letting the lower back sag.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Tricep Extensions
exercises.description: A standing skull-crusher using a fixed bar to overload the triceps.
cues: Grip a chest-height bar and step your feet back into a lean.
Bend only at the elbows to lower your head behind the bar.
Extend the arms to press yourself back to the start.
mistakes: Bending at the hips or shoulders.
Letting the elbows drift apart.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-ups
exercises.description: A wider grip emphasizes the lats for a broader, stronger back.
cues: Grip the bar wider than shoulder-width, palms facing away.
Pull your chest toward the bar, driving the elbows down.
Lower under control to a full hang.
mistakes: Cutting the range short at the bottom.
Swinging to generate momentum.

exercises.name: Negative Pull-ups
exercises.description: Lower slowly from the top to build the strength for your first full pull-up.
cues: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as possible — aim for 3 to 5 seconds.
Reset and repeat from the top each rep.
mistakes: Dropping too fast.
Relaxing the shoulders at the bottom instead of staying engaged.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-ups
exercises.description: Small shoulder-blade pulls that teach the first move of every pull-up.
cues: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Without bending the elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Lift your body slightly, then return to a relaxed hang.
mistakes: Bending the elbows.
Shrugging up instead of pulling the blades down.

exercises.name: Archer Pull-ups
exercises.description: Pull to one side at a time, a key step toward the one-arm pull-up.
cues: Take a wide grip on the bar.
Pull up toward one hand while the other arm stays straight.
Lower with control, then alternate sides.
mistakes: Bending the straight arm to assist.
Failing to pull the chin level with the working hand.

exercises.name: Commando Pull-ups
exercises.description: Pull up alongside the bar to each side, blasting the back and biceps.
cues: Grip the bar with hands together, one in front of the other.
Pull up so your head passes to one side of the bar.
Lower, then pull up to the opposite side.
mistakes: Letting the body swing side to side.
Not alternating sides evenly.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.description: A simple hang that builds the grip and shoulder strength every pulling move needs.
cues: Grip the bar shoulder-width with palms facing away.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders slightly engaged.
Hold for time, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Fully relaxing the shoulders into a dead-passive hang too soon.
Clenching the jaw and holding the breath.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description: A floor hold that strengthens the lower back and spinal muscles most people neglect.
cues: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor at once.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
mistakes: Cranking the neck back to look up.
Jerking up instead of lifting smoothly.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angels
exercises.description: Sweeping arm circles on the floor that build the upper back and rear shoulders.
cues: Lie face down with arms by your sides, palms down.
Lift your arms slightly and sweep them overhead in an arc.
Reverse the sweep back to your hips, keeping arms off the floor.
mistakes: Letting the hands rest on the floor.
Lifting the chest instead of keeping it grounded.

exercises.name: Towel Rows
exercises.description: A no-bar rowing variation using a towel anchored under a door or around a post.
cues: Loop a sturdy towel around an anchor and grip both ends.
Lean back with a straight body and arms extended.
Pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing the shoulder blades.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag.
Pulling with the arms only instead of the back.

exercises.name: Skin the Cat
exercises.description: A gymnastic rotation that builds shoulder mobility and control for advanced skills.
cues: Hang from a bar and pull your knees up toward your chest.
Rotate backward, passing your legs through and overhead.
Reverse the rotation slowly back to the hang.
mistakes: Going too deep before shoulders are ready.
Releasing tension and dropping through the rotation.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.description: An isometric hold that builds quad endurance and mental grit.
cues: Slide your back down a wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep knees stacked over the ankles at 90 degrees.
Hold for time, pressing your back flat into the wall.
mistakes: Letting the knees drift past the toes.
Sliding the hips up to cheat the angle.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.description: Explosive squats that build power, speed, and lower-body strength.
cues: Lower into a squat with the chest up.
Drive through the feet and jump as high as you can.
Land softly into the next squat, absorbing through bent knees.
mistakes: Landing with stiff, straight legs.
Collapsing the knees inward on landing.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
exercises.description: A rear-foot-elevated lunge that overloads each leg for serious single-leg strength.
cues: Place the top of one foot on a bench behind you.
Lower the front leg until the thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand back up.
mistakes: Leaning too far forward.
Letting the front knee cave inward.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.description: A simple, scalable single-leg builder using any sturdy step or box.
cues: Place one full foot on a knee-height box.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on top.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.
mistakes: Pushing off the bottom foot instead of the top leg.
Only half-extending the hip at the top.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.description: Build stronger, more resilient calves with this simple foundational move.
cues: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Push through the balls of your feet to lift your heels high.
Lower slowly until your heels nearly touch the floor.
mistakes: Bouncing through reps.
Cutting the range short at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raises
exercises.description: Double the load on each calf for stronger ankles and explosive push-off.
cues: Balance on one foot, the other tucked behind.
Rise onto the ball of your foot as high as possible.
Lower slowly under control, then switch legs.
mistakes: Using a wall for too much support.
Rushing the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
exercises.description: A knee-friendly lunge variation that builds balance and single-leg strength.
cues: Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Keep the front shin vertical and torso upright.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
mistakes: Letting the front knee travel past the toes.
Leaning the torso forward.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.description: Lunges in motion that build leg strength, balance, and coordination.
cues: Step forward into a lunge, both knees bending to 90 degrees.
Drive through the front heel to rise and step the back foot through.
Continue alternating legs as you move forward.
mistakes: Taking steps too short and crowding the knees.
Letting the torso pitch forward.

exercises.name: Cossack Squats
exercises.description: A deep side-to-side squat that builds strength, mobility, and hip control.
cues: Stand wide and shift your weight onto one bent leg.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping the other leg straight.
Push back to center and shift to the other side.
mistakes: Letting the heel of the bent leg lift.
Rounding the back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Shrimp Squats
exercises.description: A single-leg squat holding the rear foot — a brutal test of strength and balance.
cues: Stand on one leg and grab the opposite foot behind you.
Lower until your trailing knee gently touches the floor.
Drive through the standing heel to rise back up.
mistakes: Crashing the back knee into the floor.
Losing balance from looking down.

exercises.name: Nordic Curls
exercises.description: An eccentric hamstring move that builds powerful, injury-resistant legs.
cues: Kneel with your ankles anchored under a heavy object or held down.
Keep the body straight from knees to head and lower forward slowly.
Resist as long as possible, then push off and return.
mistakes: Bending at the hips to cheat.
Dropping fast instead of resisting the descent.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.description: A one-legged bridge that overloads each glute and builds hip stability.
cues: Lie on your back, one foot planted and the other leg extended.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top, then lower with control.
mistakes: Letting the hips tilt or drop on one side.
Arching the lower back to gain height.

exercises.name: Hip Thrusts
exercises.description: A bench-supported bridge that maximizes glute strength and power.
cues: Rest your upper back on a bench with feet flat on the floor.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips to a straight line.
Squeeze the glutes hard at the top, then lower under control.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top.
Pushing through the toes instead of the heels.

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.description: Explosive jumps onto a raised surface that build power and athleticism.
cues: Stand in front of a sturdy box, feet hip-width.
Dip and swing the arms, then jump and land softly on top.
Stand tall, then step down — don't jump down.
mistakes: Jumping back down and stressing the joints.
Landing with stiff, locked knees.

exercises.name: Broad Jumps
exercises.description: Horizontal jumps for distance that develop raw lower-body power.
cues: Stand with feet hip-width and swing the arms back.
Drive the arms forward and jump as far as you can.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
mistakes: Landing off-balance and stumbling.
Failing to use the arm swing for momentum.

exercises.name: Skater Hops
exercises.description: Lateral bounds that build single-leg power, balance, and knee stability.
cues: Bound sideways onto one leg, landing softly.
Let the other leg sweep behind for balance.
Immediately bound to the opposite side and repeat.
mistakes: Landing with a stiff leg.
Letting the landing knee cave inward.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunges
exercises.description: A crossover lunge that targets the glutes and inner-thigh stabilizers.
cues: Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Drive back to standing and alternate sides.
mistakes: Letting the front knee collapse inward.
Leaning the torso too far forward.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: An isometric hold that builds the obliques and lateral core stability.
cues: Lie on your side, propped on one forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so the body forms a straight line.
Hold for time, then switch sides.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag toward the floor.
Rotating the chest down.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.description: A seated rotation that targets the obliques and builds twisting strength.
cues: Sit with knees bent and lean back to a strong V-shape.
Clasp your hands and rotate your torso side to side.
Tap the floor beside each hip, keeping the chest lifted.
mistakes: Moving only the arms instead of rotating the torso.
Rounding the back.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.description: A dynamic crunch that hits the obliques and entire abdominal wall.
cues: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee as you extend the other leg.
Alternate sides in a smooth pedaling rhythm.
mistakes: Yanking on the neck.
Racing through reps without real rotation.

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.description: The classic ab builder targeting the upper abdominal muscles.
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat.
Curl your shoulders off the floor toward your knees.
Lower with control without letting the head drop.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck.
Using momentum instead of the abs.

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.description: A full range ab move working the entire front of the core.
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet anchored or flat.
Curl all the way up until your chest meets your thighs.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
mistakes: Jerking up with the arms.
Letting the lower back slam the floor on the way down.

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.description: Lift the arms and legs to meet in a V — a demanding full-core contraction.
cues: Lie flat with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift the arms and legs simultaneously to touch over your hips.
Lower both back down with control.
mistakes: Bending the knees to make it easier.
Using momentum to bounce up.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.description: Small rapid leg kicks that build endurance in the lower abs.
cues: Lie on your back with legs straight and slightly raised.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Kick the legs up and down in small, quick alternations.
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor.
Kicking too high and losing core tension.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raises
exercises.description: Hang and raise the knees to build the lower abs and a stronger grip.
cues: Hang from a bar with arms straight.
Pull your knees up toward your chest.
Lower with control, avoiding any swing.
mistakes: Swinging the body for momentum.
Using only the hip flexors without curling the pelvis.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises
exercises.description: Raise straight legs from a hang for elite lower-ab and grip strength.
cues: Hang from a bar with straight arms and legs.
Keep the legs straight and raise them to horizontal or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Bending the knees to cheat.
Using a swing to throw the legs up.

exercises.name: Toes-to-Bar
exercises.description: Bring your toes all the way to the bar — a full-range hanging core feat.
cues: Hang from a bar with an active shoulder grip.
Raise straight legs to touch your toes to the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.
mistakes: Excessive kipping swing.
Not fully extending at the bottom between reps.

exercises.name: L-sit
exercises.description: Hold your legs out straight while supported — a serious core and hip-flexor test.
cues: Press up on parallettes or the floor with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight out to form an L.
Hold for time with shoulders pressed down.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders shrug up.
Bending the knees to hold the position.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.description: A full-body lever that many call the ultimate core exercise.
cues: Lie on a bench and grip behind your head for an anchor.
Lift the whole body straight, balancing on the shoulders.
Lower slowly with the body rigid, resisting the descent.
mistakes: Bending at the hips to cheat.
Lowering too fast and losing the straight-body line.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.description: A stability move that strengthens the deep core and lower back together.
cues: Start on all fours with a flat back.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold briefly, then switch sides without letting the hips twist.
mistakes: Letting the hips rotate.
Arching or rounding the back instead of staying flat.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: A back-friendly core move that teaches bracing while the limbs move.
cues: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return and alternate, keeping the lower back pressed down.
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch up.
Rushing instead of moving with control.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunches
exercises.description: Curl the hips up to target the lower abs while sparing the neck.
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift the hips off the floor.
Lower slowly without swinging the legs.
mistakes: Using leg momentum to swing the hips.
Lifting only the legs without curling the pelvis.

exercises.name: Windshield Wipers
exercises.description: Rotate straight legs side to side for advanced oblique and control strength.
cues: Lie on your back with arms out wide and legs raised straight up.
Lower the legs to one side under control.
Sweep them across to the other side without touching the floor.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders peel off the floor.
Dropping the legs too fast.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
exercises.description: A plank with alternating taps that fights rotation and builds stability.
cues: Hold a high plank with feet slightly wide.
Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder.
Replace it and alternate, keeping the hips still.
mistakes: Rocking the hips side to side.
Widening the stance too far to make it trivial.

exercises.name: Hollow Rock
exercises.description: A rocking version of the hollow hold that adds dynamic core tension.
cues: Hold a hollow body position with arms and legs off the floor.
Maintain the tension and rock smoothly back and forth.
Keep the lower back pressed down throughout.
mistakes: Losing the hollow shape mid-rock.
Letting the lower back gap off the floor.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.description: A crawling move that builds full-body coordination, core, and shoulder strength.
cues: Start on hands and feet with knees hovering just off the floor.
Move the opposite hand and foot forward together.
Keep the hips low and back flat as you crawl.
mistakes: Letting the hips sway high.
Lifting the knees too far off the floor.

exercises.name: Crab Walk
exercises.description: A reverse crawl that lights up the triceps, shoulders, and posterior chain.
cues: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Walk forward or backward using opposite hand and foot.
Keep the hips lifted throughout.
mistakes: Letting the hips drop toward the floor.
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.description: A flowing move that builds core control while opening the hamstrings.
cues: Stand tall, then hinge and walk your hands out to a plank.
Hold the plank for a beat with a tight core.
Walk the feet back toward the hands and stand up.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag in the plank.
Bending the knees excessively on the walk-out.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: A classic cardio move to raise the heart rate and warm up the whole body.
cues: Start with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump the feet wide while raising the arms overhead.
Jump back to the start in a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Landing flat-footed and hard.
Only half-raising the arms.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: A running-in-place drill that spikes the heart rate and fires the core.
cues: Run in place, driving the knees up to hip height.
Stay on the balls of your feet with a tall posture.
Pump the arms in time with the legs.
mistakes: Leaning back as the knees rise.
Letting the knees stay low.

exercises.name: Squat Thrusts
exercises.description: A burpee without the jump or push-up — explosive conditioning for the whole body.
cues: Drop into a squat and plant your hands on the floor.
Jump both feet back into a plank.
Jump the feet forward and stand tall.
mistakes: Letting the hips pike up in the plank.
Rounding the back on the jump back.

exercises.name: Plank Jacks
exercises.description: A plank with jumping feet that adds cardio to your core training.
cues: Hold a strong plank on hands or forearms.
Jump the feet out wide, then back together.
Keep the hips level and core braced throughout.
mistakes: Letting the hips bounce up and down.
Losing the straight-body line.
